title: WebSocket Connection Over Plaintext ws:// Instead of wss://
description: Real-time alert streaming connects via `WebSocketChannel.connect(Uri.parse('ws://...'))` using unencrypted WebSocket transport instead of TLS-protected `wss://`.
attack_vector: Network adversaries along the routing path inspect cleartext WebSocket upgrade headers and frames, stealing session tokens or injecting fabricated parental alert events into the live stream.
fix_rationale: Always establish WebSocket channels over TLS using the `wss://` scheme (`Uri.parse('wss://...')`).
